verdict.rationale: Braintrust is an observability and eval platform with its own agent (Loop) and playgrounds, so connecting MCP servers as tool sources is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only documents Braintrust's own MCP server, which external clients like Claude Code and Cursor connect to. That is the server role and does not count for this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Loop, playgrounds, or prompts consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
